title: dieteria canescens
intro: Dieteria canescens, commonly known as woolly marigold, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is traditionally used to treat digestive issues, sore throats, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Dieteria canescens include its ability to soothe and protect the mucous membranes, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Dieteria canescens include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
